name: Theatrical Troupe's Boat
summary:
This painting is from a set of 50 depicting the different types of boats that cluttered the Pearl River. It shows a theatrical troupe's boat, in which players travelled by river to perform in different towns and counties. Paintings such as this were mass-produced as souvenir items.

Lord George Ma
